template.name: Target Area Coverage Pass
template.description: One drone flies to a named target, hovers over it and delivers two photographs as evidence. Use it when the scenario needs proof that a specific site was visited and imaged.
template.content: Have {drone_name} take off to {random_alt:22:30:1} meters and fly to the target {target_name}. Hold position over the target and take two photographs of it, then stay hovering above the target.
content_aliases: {drone_name} climbs to {random_alt:22:30:1} m, flies to {target_name} and takes two photos of it.
Photo pass on {target_name}: {drone_name} at {random_alt:22:30:1} m, hover over the target, two photographs, keep hovering afterwards.
{target_name} needs photo evidence; {drone_name} goes there at {random_alt:22:30:1} m and shoots two frames.
template.creator: Xie Qidong
